seo.title: Breathe Easy — Guided Breathing for iPhone and Apple Watch
seo.description: Guided breathing with a calm visual guide and a tap at each change of breath. Six patterns, an Apple Watch app, a widget, and mindful minutes in Apple Health. No account.

hero.label: GUIDED BREATHING
hero.title: Breathe in, breathe easy.
text: A calm guide for a few slow minutes of breathing. Pick a pattern, follow the circle or the taps, and let your mindful minutes add up. No account, no subscription, no data collection.

items.title: Six patterns
items.text: Box breathing, 4-7-8, coherent breathing, Nadi Shodhana, Ujjayi and pursed-lip breathing, for 1, 3, 5 or 10 minutes.

items.title: A guide that keeps time
items.text: A soft disc fills the ring as you breathe in and empties as you breathe out, and an arc sweeps each phase, so holds show their time too. With Reduce Motion, it stays still.

items.title: Feel each breath
items.text: A distinct tap marks breathing in, holding and breathing out, right on each change. Close your eyes and follow along.

items.title: Apple Watch
items.text: The same guide and taps on your wrist, carrying on with your wrist down. Finished sessions join your history on iPhone.

items.title: Apple Health
items.text: Turn it on and every session you finish is saved as mindful minutes. Breathe Easy writes mindful minutes and reads nothing.

items.title: Today at a glance
items.text: Today's mindful minutes and the days in a row lead the app, and the widget shows them on your Home Screen with a one-tap start.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Zero data collection.
text: No accounts, analytics, ads or tracking, and no network requests. Your sessions stay on your device, and in Apple Health only if you choose.

cta.title: Start breathing.
cta.text: Free on the App Store, with an Apple Watch app. No account required.
